name: James Alfred McKeldin
notable_stories: Worked as a tinsmith and sheet metal worker in Baltimore
Tinsmith per 1916 Baltimore City Directory; sheet metal clerk at C.D. Prude per WWI draft registration
Lived at 615 W. Hamburg St., later 1000 Russell St.
Buried Mount Olivet Cemetery (plot O, 122, S/2, #1)

Lived at 615 W. Hamburg Street, then 1000 Russell Street, Baltimore.
Both James Alfred and Dorothea buried at Mount Olivet Cemetery, Baltimore (plot: O, 122, S/2, #1).
